components.name: CLI
components.summary: The `agency` command: dispatches init, serve, check, context, mcp and hook subcommands.

components.name: Store
components.summary: Reads and writes everything in .agency/: map, wiki pages, log, state, decisions, search and the AI context briefing.

components.name: MCP server
components.summary: Tools AIs use to read and edit what the user sees: context, search, map edits, wiki writes, refresh, decisions.

components.name: Claude Code hooks
components.summary: Session start briefing, edit tracking, end-of-turn stale nudge, git post-commit attribution, statusline badge.

components.name: Installer
components.summary: init scaffolds .agency/ and wires Claude Code via npx; --plugin skips what the plugin provides.

components.name: GUI server
components.summary: Local HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 with a per-run token: JSON API, live updates over SSE, git history of the map.

components.name: GUI
components.summary: Browser app: Map, Wiki (two editor modes), Decisions, Timeline, AI View. Bundled by esbuild.

components.name: Self-check
components.summary: One end-to-end check: init, hooks and a real MCP round-trip against a temp repo.

components.name: Project config & docs
components.summary: Package manifest, plan, README, agent instructions and Claude Code wiring for this repo.

components.name: Claude Code plugin
components.summary: Plugin + marketplace manifests that bundle the MCP server, hooks and skill so enabling it starts Agency with no per-project setup.

edges.why: check and context commands read the store directly
`agency hook <name>` and `agency statusline` run hook handlers
every tool is a thin wrapper over store functions
logs edits, marks components stale, tracks session usage
creates .agency/ files and the init event
API endpoints read/write pages, decisions, search
serves the bundled app and pushes live updates
imports src/md.js so frontmatter and AI-block rules match the server exactly
drives the real MCP server over stdio
Its MCP server and hooks run `npx agency-dev` through bin/launch.cjs
